notes.title: Enhanced Controls and Fixes
notes.content: [p]This new patch improves your gameplay with these updates:[/p][list][*][p][b]Controller & Keyboard Support[/b]: Navigate menus and play Pawsky with a controller or keyboard for a more flexible experience.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Settings Menu Fix[/b]: Fixed a bug where audio settings weren’t saving, so your preferences now stick.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Action Button Delay[/b]: Added a short delay to the in-game action button for smoother interactions and to avoid accidental presses.[/p][/*][/list][p]ːsteamthumbsupː Thank you for playing and sharing your feedback.[/p]

notes.title: Pawsky Goes Global with New Languages!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45484376/3eb0a8370a7655bcba3feb5ff1bef186eff6e699.jpg[/img]
Hello! I'm thrilled to announce that Pawsky has expanded its reach with new language support! You can now enjoy the game in:
[list]
[b][*] German
[*] French
[*] Italian
[*] Korean
[*] Spanish
[*] Simplified Chinese
[*] Japanese
[*] Polish
[*] Brazilian Portuguese
[*] Latvian[/b]
[/list]
Dive into the adorable and exciting world of Pawsky in your native language. This update brings our community closer together, making the game more accessible and fun for players worldwide.
Thank you for your support, and start your adventure today!

notes.title: Pawsky out now!
notes.content:
Pawsky is here! 🎉 The lovable black cat is live on Steam.
Dive into a whimsical adventure filled with playful exploration and charming challenges.
Grab your copy on Steam and start your journey with Pawsky.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45484376/aacd43b325e8e56f798406af89f7e3d43cb4f6a6.gif[/img]

notes.title: Status Progress Update
notes.content:
Pawsky has hit [b]100[/b] wishlists! ːsteamhappyː

It may not seem like much, but every milestone counts!
In other news, say hello to a new character joining the story:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45484376/abbd290e1e549ab9241bf1e9c9eac219dd2d5ac0.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now—see you soon in [b]Pawsky[/b]!
